Plot Quality Distribution

Source: R/plot_quality_distribution.R
plot_quality_distribution.Rd

Generates an interactive plot with number of reads at each Q score sorted by pass/fail filtering status. Vertical line represents Q score cut-off which is by default equal to 7. The basecaller threshold line is only drawn when both passing and failing reads are present in the data.

Usage

plot_quality_distribution(seq_summary, qscore_cutoff = 7)

Arguments

seq_summary

A dataframe containing the sequencing summary

qscore_cutoff

Numeric parameter of Qscore cut-off

Value

plotly object

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_quality_distribution(sample_data)
} # }
